channel.title: Sicario
channel.desc: After rising through the ranks of her male-dominated profession, idealistic FBI agent Kate Macer receives a top assignment. Recruited by mysterious government official Matt Graver, Kate joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense and shadowy Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the US Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one.[(96057)]
